description: This file contains JavaScript code that initializes and manages terminal-like UI components, handles dynamic content display such as announcements, and manages sponsor images on a webpage.

methods.name: setupTermynal
methods.description: Initializes terminal-like components on elements with class 'use-termynal', configuring line delays and content parsing.

methods.name: shuffle
methods.description: Randomly shuffles elements in an array.

methods.name: showRandomAnnouncement
methods.description: Displays random announcements within a specified group at a set interval.

methods.name: handleSponsorImages
methods.description: Ensures sponsor images are loaded before displaying sponsor-related content and initiating announcements.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function that sets up terminal components, shows announcements, and handles sponsor images.
